I told Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team: "Hollis, it's 382 seats. Tobias posted that here on Oct 14 as the seat count for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal. I haven't seen any later change in this channel or the team files."

I only looked at what Hollis can see himself: #central-team, which he's a member of, and the public team files. Nothing there changes the number after Tobias's post. A seat count isn't a finance figure, and he's on the account's team, so no approval was needed.
